messages:
Samir Patel: Quick proposal — let's tighten our postmortem follow-ups. I keep seeing remediation items slip past 30d. I sketched a lightweight timeline + ownership model. Want feedback before I add it to the incident-process doc.

Mira Chen: +1. We need something lightweight and enforceable. Long spreadsheets don't get looked at.

Devon Lee: Agree. Can we also add a short SLA for remediation owners? e.g., acknowledge in 48h, plan in 5d?

Samir Patel: Yup — thinking: acknowledge (48h), remediation plan (D+5), patch/mitigation (D+14), verification & close (D+30). If owner misses D+5, escalation to IC.

Alex K: Sounds reasonable. Can you drop the timeline snippet here so I can paste it into the runbook?

Samir Patel: Sure — template I propose (super short):

```
Incident timeline template:
- D0 (incident): Incident Commander (IC) assigned, severity, initial comms (15m)
- D+1: Initial RCA notes + designate remediation owner (RO)
- D+5: Remediation plan with milestones + RO acknowledgement (48h SLA to accept)
- D+14: Implemented mitigation or patch in staging/prod (or documented blocker)
- D+30: Verification complete, retro + closeout checklist, and release notes update
```

Jamal Rivera: Love the clear owners. Could we add a small tracking row for recurring pattern tags? e.g., "networking", "kv-cache", "model-serve" so we can do trend analysis.

Samir Patel: Good call — add column: PatternTags. Also add 'Recurring? true|false' to the tracker.

Devon Lee: Comms cadence? I want clearer expectations for internal vs external comms. I suggest: page + initial mention in #incidents, 1h update if incident ongoing then every 4h, postmortem published within 72h (draft) and final within 14d.

Mira Chen: +1 on timeline for public-facing comms. For customers we should default to 'we are investigating' then a follow-up with impact once RCA available. Legal/Security triage may change wording.

Alex K: Roles quick reference: IC, Incident Scribe, Comms Lead, Remediation Owner, QA Verifier. Make scribe assignable to IC.

Samir Patel: Proposed IC rotation: 2-week rotation aligned to oncall buckets. Each rotation includes a shadow handover doc and 1hr overlapping handoff with outgoing IC. Opt-out allowed with delegate.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation starts 2026-04-01.

Jamal Rivera: Two-week seems fine. We should monitor IC load, might need to shorten if too heavy.

Mira Chen: One more process ask — require a single follow-up owner per remediation item (no shared ownership). If multiple teams involved, list collaborators but one RO owns deadlines.

Samir Patel: Agreed. I'll create a simple Google sheet template with these columns: IncidentID, Severity, IC, RO, AcknowledgeTS, PlanDue, PatchDue, VerifyDue, PatternTags, Recurring, Notes, LinkToPR. I'll also add a short escalation flow for missed milestones.

Devon Lee: Can you add an automation to ping the RO when PlanDue is within 48h of D+5? Our task bot can do that.

Samir Patel: Yep — I'll open a PR to the ops-runbook and add a zap/automation to the sheet. If no major objections I'll merge by EOD Tuesday.

Alex K: No objections from me.

Mira Chen: Fine by me.

Jamal Rivera: 👍 I'll volunteer to be first RO tester next week.

Samir Patel: Thanks Jamal. If others want to volunteer for the initial trial (1 month), reply here. I'll create the doc and tag folks.

Devon Lee: I can help wire the bot pings.

Samir Patel: Sweet — will follow up with PR link. Closing thread for now, continuing in the runbook PR. :thumbsup:
